headline: Here are our favorite deals from REI’s giant Holiday Sale
summary: REI's Holiday Sale is live, featuring significant discounts on outdoor gear. These are part of early Black Friday deals. It's an ideal opportunity to save on essentials for upcoming trips.

headline: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
summary: Helen Toner, former OpenAI board member, discusses AI safety and governance. She asserts that AI CEOs should not be blindly trusted. This interview is part of a series on AI in real life, reflecting on the Sam Altman incident.

headline: Tesla is inviting some people to buy a Cybercab ‘for personal use’ — but read the fine print
summary: Tesla is offering a Cybercab for 'personal use' to select customers. This steering-wheel-free two-seater emphasizes the autonomous future. However, purchases are restricted to specific 'supported service areas' with important fine print.

headline: This tiny gamepad with dual analog thumbsticks pushes the limits of portable controllers
summary: A new tiny gamepad features impressive dual analog thumbsticks. It aims to provide a superior portable gaming experience compared to Joy-Cons. This controller is designed for use with the Switch 2, iOS, and Android devices.

headline: Breaking Down Theo's Shock Moment in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 and the Mystery of His Father With Actor Tyroe Muhafidin
summary: An interview with Tyroe Muhafidin delves into Theo's pivotal moment in The Rings of Power Season 3. The actor discusses the ongoing mystery surrounding Theo's father. This article contains significant spoilers for the series.

headline: James Gunn Shuts Down Rumors That Skydance Is Meddling With Man of Tomorrow
summary: James Gunn refutes rumors about Skydance interfering with his film, Man of Tomorrow. Speculation arose following his exit from DC Studios. Gunn assures fans of his creative control over the project.

headline: Sunrise on the Reaping Is Getting Multiple Black Friday Deals Before Its Theatrical Release
summary: Early Black Friday deals are already available for 'Sunrise on the Reaping.' Discounts apply to the book and audiobook versions. These promotions precede the story's theatrical release.

headline: After Another Year of Price Hikes, What Streaming Deals Will We Get for Black Friday 2026?
summary: Streaming services saw significant price increases throughout the year. Consumers are eagerly awaiting Black Friday 2026 for potential deals. The article anticipates how providers will respond to rising costs.

headline: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
summary: A forthcoming review proposes a legal guarantee for young people to receive a job or training. This change could lead to some young individuals losing out on benefits. The review aims to address high youth unemployment rates.

headline: Neets review won't be for the faint-hearted - and will test Burnham's appetite for a welfare fight
summary: Milburn's review on NEETs (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) is expected to be contentious. It will challenge Andy Burnham's stance on welfare policy. The article questions the effectiveness of this new approach compared to previous attempts.

headline: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
summary: President Zelensky claims the US proposed Ukraine cede the Donbas region. This offer was reportedly linked to a path for NATO membership. The suggestion was part of ongoing efforts to resolve the war with Russia.

headline: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand
summary: Noel Fielding expresses deep regret over past jokes shared with Russell Brand. The Great British Bake Off presenter confirms he has not been in contact with Brand for 'many years.' His comments follow Brand's recent conviction for serious offenses.
